benchmarks.method: Trusted local baseline function extracted from exact Git blob; candidate imported from production. 10 valid fixed synthetic FENs, 3 warmups per case/arm, 25 measured paired rounds, alternating baseline/candidate order. Inputs and assertions outside timing; perf_counter_ns wall time plus process_time_ns CPU. No GC or process-affinity changes. Nearest-rank empirical P95. SAN call counting in separate untimed runs.
benchmarks.correctness: Full output list compared at each run; input board and move stack must remain unchanged. Separate seeded histories also compare raw FEN, history, and root board.
benchmarks.scope: Local Python tactical scan only. No end-to-end model, GPU, Windows, browser or network latency claim.

limitations: 25 samples give descriptive empirical P95, not a production-tail guarantee.
Host CPU scheduling and frequency were not isolated; paired alternating order limits drift.

Terminal positions are practically unchanged; no SAN formatting occurred in either version.
Full Allie/model startup and real Windows/Edge acceptance remain unmeasured.

read_only_hotpath_findings.observation: Model initialization stays under an RLock with integrity verification, pinned revision, trust_remote_code=False and local_files_only=True. No model load performed.
Analysis cache has max 24 entries and 30-second TTL with copied results; no cache semantics changed.
Latest analysis job carries generation/session data; worker rejects obsolete results. No queue/locking changes.
Detector/predictor are reused and RapidOCR is lazy; OCR is throttled to at least seven seconds. No native OCR benchmark performed.
MutationObserver ignores own overlay changes and schedules ticks with 120 ms debounce; geometry repaints use requestAnimationFrame. No keepalive change.
Frame capture has in-flight and tick/session guards; captureSize controls dimensions before JPEG conversion. No browser timing claim.
Stockfish UCI process is reused under lock, with existing time/root-move limits. No engine-budget or candidate-order change.
